summary: Flat residential kerb with homes 12-14 m behind it; cars park here.

drivers.seclusion: Houses 12-14 m behind the south kerb, with more across the road; no bush or park buffer.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; cars park on the kerb, so there is room to stop.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the street; no camping convention.

flags: Low-lying: about 8 m elevation, waterway 54 m away
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees give some shade near the 0 m end.

best_section.where: Dobell Street south kerb, west of the corner bend
